name: Power & Battery Management
shortDesc: CPU frequency scaling, battery thresholds, and thermal power profiles.
detailedDesc: Essential for laptops to optimize battery life and quiet fan acoustics.

phase.title: Audio, Hardware & Connectivity
phase.description: PipeWire audio stack, Bluetooth, NetworkManager, screen brightness, and power management.

packages.name: power-profiles-daemon (Recommended)
packages.description: Modern power state controller providing Power Saver, Balanced, and Performance modes. Native integration with SwayNC and Waybar.
pros: Instant switching between quiet battery and high performance
cons: Less granular manual tuning than TLP

packages.name: auto-cpufreq
packages.description: Automatic CPU speed and power optimizer for Linux laptops based on live system load.
pros: Intelligently scales governor based on battery vs AC status

packages.name: TLP
packages.description: Advanced power management daemon for Linux laptops with extensive battery thresholds.
pros: Dozens of granular kernel and hardware power toggles
